title: La Savoyarde (Sacré-Cœur, Paris)
status_note: Gift of the four dioceses of Savoie.

place.label: Bell tower, Basilica of Sacré-Cœur, Montmartre, Paris

timeline.event: Cast by Paccard at Annecy-le-Vieux (the bell is inscribed 1890; one page line says 1895)
Arrives at Montmartre, drawn by 28 horses

tiers.everyday: La Savoyarde is the 19-tonne bell of Sacré-Cœur in Paris. It was hauled up Montmartre by 28 horses in 1895.
tiers.student: The basilica says Paccard cast it on 12 May 1891 at Annecy-le-Vieux (inscribed 1890; another line on the page says 1895, a conflict we keep open). It reached Montmartre on 16 October 1895 drawn by 28 horses; 19 t, low C, given by the dioceses of Savoie.
